description: Exploit, the decisive test of the E046 crux (W2/W3/W5/W6). On the E036 tip, apply E046's group-2 freeze exactly as committed in 8a2452a. Group-2 filters and BN params get their own groups, with LR annealed from 75% to 0 at 90% of steps. For the last 10% of steps, group 2's output is detached before group 3, using the truncated 32 px variant. Group-2 BN stays in train mode and Lookahead averages every param. On top of that, add 0.25 true epoch (231 → 237 steps, all schedules kept as fractions). Capture the variants in build, with error_on_recompile on. Judge in the same build session as I074, against the same-build E036 baseline and the I074 arm on seeds 13–32, plus seeds 0–2. Decision: if time is at least 2% below E036 and the 20-seed mean is within 0.03 pp of E036 or above it, the cascade-plus-top-up dominates E036 and becomes the base for further margin buying. If it trails the I074 arm by more than 0.15 pp, the group-2 freeze is no better than the dial and the cascade closes.
